body:
## Pull request overview

Updates the project roadmap documentation to prioritize v4.0 schema/toolchain infrastructure work (Zod v4 + interoperability outputs) alongside existing v4.0 platform goals.

**Changes:**
- Adds a new “v4.0 Schema & Toolchain Roadmap” section with P0–P3 priority table.
- Updates the v4.0 entry in the Versioning Plan to include schema/toolchain initiatives.
- Updates the Table of Contents to include the new section and adjusted anchors.

The roadmap lists a specific "2-7x" performance improvement for Zod v4. Consider either adding a citation/link to the benchmark source or rephrasing to a qualified statement (e.g., "expected"/"reported"), and formatting the range more unambiguously (e.g., "2×–7×" or "2x–7x").
```suggestion
| **P0** | Complete Zod v4 migration | Reported 2×–7× performance improvement in community benchmarks + built-in JSON Schema support |
```
